text:
The home mountain of the Greek Gods is Mount Olympus.

To help you understand the second part of the text, here is an analogy:

Imagine the Internet is like a massive, chaotic city where every building is a website and every room inside those buildings is a web page. If you were looking for a specific room (like a recipe for chocolate cake), wandering around blindly would take forever. A search engine like Google acts like a super-efficient city guide or a librarian who knows exactly which building and which room contains what you are looking for, saving you from getting lost in the crowd.
